items.html: But the Mocha, which is beneath the skull, and which is internal, standing within it, does not reveal its corrections in the place of the skull — that is, the head and the face, the aspect of that which surrounds and encompasses the inner Mocha. Rather, it brings out its powers below the place of the skull, in the secret of hairs that emerge from it outward, within the corrections of the beard, as was said. For each of these two is divided into ten internal Sefirot and ten encompassing Sefirot — see their existence there — except that they are also divided into the aspect of thirteen corrections, for the ten Sefirot themselves are divided into thirteen for the aforementioned reason.
